observations.statement: C008 reuses fifteen hypotheses from earlier cycles and adds only five theta descendants; the inversion matrix is therefore rooted primarily in existing JANUS work.
The generic SAT-to-independent-set reduction followed by the first Lovasz theta relaxation is not a universal refutation method for random 3CNF in the Feige-Ofek regime.
Theta bodies form an SDP hierarchy related to Lasserre/SoS; transferring rank claims into proof complexity requires explicit coefficient and size accounting rather than terminology alone.
A useful inversion test must be applicable to multiple inherited hypotheses; tests that merely restate one hypothesis are not admitted to the shared matrix.
Theta rank is being treated as a candidate residual obstruction, not as evidence for P = NP or P != NP.
